release_notes: Fixed Pulse Glass RUN timing: Renderer Pulls now waits up to 15 seconds for City Island to expose renderer, scene, camera and canvas before starting the adapter.
The previous blocking browser alert is replaced by in-app WAITING / STARTING / ACTIVE status text and a bounded error modal only if City never becomes render-ready.
Pulse Glass 141 remains experimental and unbenchmarked; no performance score is prefilled.
Running another renderer still restores Legacy Three before the next candidate starts.
